prompt: Someone Is at Your Door: whispered jazz-funk / trip-hop at 70 bpm; auditions of basses, kits, trumpet, Rhodes and whisper voices before the song is arranged

requests.ask: prove out the voices and instruments first, parts to narrow down, not the whole song

changes.why: audition sections, one candidate per section or per two bars, to be cut down once instruments and voices are chosen

requests.ask: bass_a yes but cymbals too loud; no rhodes; davis (tony for variation); curtain loved; echo_b minus nancy; low_c no; far_d inaudible

changes.why: ride moved out of the kit into its own part at three candidate levels (.15/.25/.35), clipped to .6 and darkened: its sample rings 1.4 s at the kick's loudness
basses B/C, jazz kit, rhodes, nancy, jason/guy cut; swing matched to the kit's .12
hpf 900>400, lpf 2200>3200, level .5>1.2: the band cut away the whispered voice's body
Tony replaces Jason and Guy, plainer: no speed drop

requests.ask: ride takes too long; narrator: the four words, voices doubled; no woman under curtain; echo_b perfect; delete low_c and far_d; overlap minus the slowed voice

changes.why: ride hits cut to a sixteenth (clip 3>1, release .05), one groove section instead of three ride levels
Davis and Tony on the same line at once, Tony 20 ms late, a touch left, x.8
the pitched-down Tony line removed; low_c and far_d sections and their clips deleted

requests.ask: the sections were too long, not the ride; narrator double length, each voice says it twice

changes.why: ride back to ~.65 s hits; groove 4>2 bars, trumpet 6>4 (the gaps between comments closed), curtain 4>2
bars: Davis twice, then Tony twice, taking turns rather than doubled
